about: Human-maintained kit -> MS fixes for scripts/atlas/build_gundam_ms.mjs. kits: {"<kit_id from data/kits.json>": ["<Gundam Wiki MS title or gget:<unit id>>", ...]}. Overrides always win over the automatic cascade. Pick kit ids from data/atlas/gundam-review-queue.json. units: {"<GGET unit id>": "<Gundam Wiki MS title>"} attaches a GGET unit to a page its name does not match. Keep one entry per line, no indentation.
